managedRuntimes.name: align
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (torch and torchaudio 2.10.0 with the pinned MMS forced-alignment model; cold-start lyric timing)

managedRuntimes.name: stems
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (Demucs 4.1.0 and optional pinned htdemucs, htdemucs_ft and htdemucs_6s; cold-start stem splitting)

managedRuntimes.name: voice-convert
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (SoulX-Singer SVC, PyTorch MPS, pinned Apache-2.0 weights; singing voice conversion)

managedRuntimes.name: recorded-speech
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (separate mlx-audio 0.6.4 environment and pinned Fish Audio Drama 3 4-bit model; recorded speech only)

managedRuntimes.name: pocket-tts
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (torch 2.13 ships macOS 14 wheels only; a hashed requirements file per platform, the Linux files land with the first Linux tts run)

managedRuntimes.name: mlx-audio
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; the Stack's second voice engine, Chatterbox Turbo, VOICE-STUDIO-01; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: voxcpm2
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; a separate mlx-audio 0.6.4 environment for the VoxCPM2 voice engine, VOICE-VOXCPM2-01; started only when the voice engine setting names VoxCPM2; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: omlx
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 15 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; opt-in chat engine (`stack.engines.chat.engine` = `omlx`), never the default: llama-server is the default on every tier, ENGINE-MLX-02; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: comfyui
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (torch 2.13 ships macOS 14 wheels only; a hashed requirements file per platform, the source archive is the same on every platform)

managedRuntimes.name: video-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; the mlx-video source archive plus a hashed requirements file; Wan2.2 TI2V-5B FastWan, text and picture to video, no sound; needs 64 GB or more; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: ltx25-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; the LTX-2.5 runtime source archive (fork of dgrauet/ltx-2-mlx) plus a hashed requirements file; text to video with a sound track made in the same pass; needs 64 GB or more; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: mask-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (SAM 2.1 source archive and hashed Python 3.12 requirements; MPS tracking; no Linux file yet)

managedRuntimes.name: composite-swap
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (numpy and OpenCV only, no torch; the head-only composite of a swap: donor pixels inside a tracked head mask, every original pixel outside it kept; a hashed requirements file; no Linux file yet)

managedRuntimes.name: minimax-h3-video-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS arm64 (pinned H3 MLX runtime)

managedRuntimes.name: ltx25-max-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; the dgrauet ltx-2-mlx 0.18.0 source archive plus a hashed requirements file; the Max LTX-2.5 slot, 1024x576 with a sound track; needs 128 GB; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: music-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; the ACE-Step 1.5 source archive plus a hashed requirements file; songs with sung lyrics, remakes, covers, repaints and extensions; needs 64 GB or more; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: sfx-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (torch 2.7.1 MPS; the stable-audio-3 source archive plus a hashed requirements file; Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX sound effects, 1 to 47 seconds, about 5.3 GB while it runs; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: score-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (Spotify Basic Pitch 0.4.0 with ONNX and a hashed requirements file; model bundled in the package; about 1 GB while it runs; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: image-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; mflux 0.23.0 and a hashed requirements file; FLUX.2 Klein 4B, FLUX 3 Image Klein, Z-Image-Turbo and other optional picture families; needs 32 GB of memory or more)

managedRuntimes.name: h3-image-gen
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (MLX is Apple silicon only; h3-image-mlx 0.1.0a8 from PyPI (Apache-2.0 code, MLX 0.32.4) and a hashed requirements file, in its own environment because its MLX differs from mflux's; MiniMax H3-Image text to picture and reference edits, one process per picture; resident at 19.7 GB measured, or streamed from disk at 1.8 GB; no Linux file)

managedRuntimes.name: image-tools
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (onnxruntime, numpy, pillow, opencv; no torch; remove background, erase, upscale, resize and make a depth map for a picture the person has, and sharpen clips through the media.edit upscale op; the Linux file lands with the robot's first image run)

managedRuntimes.name: liveportrait
managedRuntimes.platforms: macOS 14 or later on arm64 (Apple MPS only; MIT LivePortrait pinned source and weights; still mouth and eye retargeting)
